Chapter 6731: Dao’S End Halo

Chapter 6731: Dao’s End Halo

“Who can this be?” This was the question on everyone’s mind.

Letting go was the stage at which a cultivator becomes eligible to fight against the high heaven. Most immortals had little knowledge of the process. Only the celestial immortals who had reached the shore understood the difference; they were also aware of the mystical being known as “that person”.

Some have tried to peer into this cultivator’s past. Alas, it was an unfruitful endeavor.

“I will take a look.” A shored cultivator entered the river of time, crossing through one branch after another. He discovered two immense powers existing in the past, present, and future.

The powers did not allow refusal, not even from him.

“Bam!” They sent him back to the present.

Others had similar experiences. Upon feeling the powers, they immediately switched their hiding location.

“An unimaginable fight is happening...” They, the lords of Heaven Realm, couldn’t watch the fight.

The powers suppressed all worlds and timelines, immobilizing everyone.

An elusive cultivator noticed the shockwaves and calculated with his fingers.

“Master’s enemy...” He was shocked: “How did I not predict this before?”

He felt uneasy and entered a new temporal timeline for a different hiding spot.

“The high heaven will change.” He calculated an unprecedented scenario and saw a corner of the future. He would stand with the winner. Thus, it became a matter of waiting.

“Bam!” A loud blast detonated in everyone’s mind, signaling the spread of an omnipresent supreme will.

Immortals felt themselves losing control over their fate. The will then grasped all worlds like an invisible hand.

“No!!!” Immortals bellowed in horror.

“It’s reaching the climax.” A shored immortal said.

Earlier, the two sides merely exchanged blows on the unknown battlefield. Nevertheless, shockwaves still leaked outward as the battle intensified.

Now, the presence of this will meant they have resorted to their ace cards. Suddenly, a radiant halo stretched across the worlds, making them infinitely larger. This applied to everyone’s grand dao as well.

“What is happening?” Many heaved a sigh of relief after being freed from the invisible hand.

Alas, their dao continued to expand as if ready to create an internal world. Their body was stretched to unimaginable proportions.

At first, the supreme will restricted them and now everything has expanded beyond their control.

“Dao’s End Halo!” Someone hidden in space shouted in horror and delved even deeper into the dimensions.

“Run now!” Overlords and immortals fled with great haste.

Unfortunately, others were subjected to unrestricted growth. Once the internal world and inhabitants became too much for their dao to take, their dao crumbled.

This included regular cultivators from the minor worlds and the big shots in the nine major worlds.

This meant everyone beneath the overlord realm, regardless of their cultivation path, lost their cultivation. Humans, metals, fallen paths... everything shattered.

They became mortals again, unaware of the name of the dao that had just caused this - Dao’s End Halo.
